title: US B1/B2 Visitor Visa
feeNote: The US visa application (MRV) fee is paid separately.
processingTime: Depends on interview wait times at the US embassy or consulate
stay: Decided at the port of entry
appointment: Interview at the US Consulate in Lagos or the Embassy in Abuja
summary: For tourism, family visits and business meetings in the US. We complete your DS-160, book your interview and prepare you for it.
overview: The B1/B2 visa covers business and tourist visits to the United States. The interview is the key step, so beyond the DS-160 form and appointment booking we run a practice interview with you so you can explain your trip clearly and confidently.
requirements: Proof of employment, business or studies
Bank statements and evidence of ties to Nigeria

steps.title: Free assessment on WhatsApp
steps.description: We look at your purpose of travel and history and advise on your chances.

steps.title: DS-160 form
steps.description: We complete the DS-160 with you and check every answer for consistency.

steps.title: Fee payment and appointment
steps.description: We guide you through the fee payment and book the earliest interview slot available.

steps.title: Interview preparation
steps.description: A practice session covering the questions officers commonly ask.

steps.title: After the interview
steps.description: We help with passport collection and plan your trip once approved.

excluded: Flights and hotels (we can quote separately)

faqs.q: How long is the wait for an interview?
faqs.a: Wait times change often. We check the current wait for Lagos and Abuja and tell you before you pay the fee.
